turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to fix this weird issue where my app hangs when connecting to the legacy database. Any ideas?
Hi Alan. Hangs can often be due to connection pooling issues or missing timeouts. Does it happen on every query or just specific ones?
Just the ones hitting the old metadata tables. I also need to check if the new security patch broke anything else.
I can help with that. What did you change in the security patch?
I tightened the permissions. Specifically, A read-only guarded SELECT query arm is implemented over kg.sqlite for schema discovery. I want to make sure that's not causing the hang.
Understood. That setup should generally be safe for schema discovery unless the query itself is unoptimized.
Right. By the way, did the package for the new server arrive?
The tracking number shows it was delivered to your office yesterday.
Lloyd, the hang is gone. Turns out it was a network timeout setting. I'm updating the docs now.
Great news, Alan. Glad it was something simple. Do you need help with the documentation text?
Maybe later. For now, I'm just verifying the data access layer. Read-only guarded SELECT queries are used over kg.sqlite for schema discovery.
Noted. That aligns with the previous security implementation.
Yeah. Oh, and the weather is supposed to rain all week, so I'll cancel the picnic plans.
That's a shame about the picnic, but staying dry sounds better.
Exactly. Can you remind me to buy milk when I get home?
I've added milk to your shopping list.
